name: Oracle - Sys Audit Log - Logon Analysis
description: See logon activity information derived from the syslog audit trail, including successful and failed logons, logon status trends, multiple database user logons and client user logons from the same UserHost, and multiple UserHost  logons with the same database user.
title: Oracle - Sys Audit Log - Logon Analysis

panels.title: Multiple Client User Logons From Same UserHost

queries.queryString:
db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "STATUS:[1] '0'" "ACTION :[7] 'CONNECT'"
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message "
LENGTH : '*'
ACTION :[*] '*'
DATABASE USER:[*] '*'
PRIVILEGE :[*] '*'
CLIENT USER:[*] '*'
CLIENT TERMINAL:[*] '*'
STATUS:[*] '*'
DBID:[*] '*'
SESSIONID:[*] '*'
USERHOST:[*] '*'
CLIENT ADDRESS:[*] '*'
ACTION NUMBER:[*] '*'" as totallength, actionlength, Action, databaseuserlength, databaseUser, privilegelength, privilege, clientuserlength, clientUser, clientterminallength, clientTerminal, statuslength, status, dbidlength, dbid, sessionlength, sessionid, userhostlength, userHost, clientaddresslength, clientAddress, actionnumberlength, actionNumber
| where status="0" and Action="CONNECT" // Successful Connection
| fields clientAddress , Action, databaseUser, privilege, clientUser, userHost, clientTerminal, status, dbid
| count_distinct (clientUser) as %"UniqueClientUsers" by userHost
| 0 as threshold 
| where %"UniqueClientUsers" > threshold
| sort by userHost, %"UniqueClientUsers"
| fields -threshold

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle !"STATUS:[1] '0'" "ACTION :[7] 'CONNECT'"
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message "\nLENGTH : '*'\nACTION :[*] '*'\nDATABASE USER:[*] '*'\nPRIVILEGE :[*] '*'\nCLIENT USER:[*] '*'\nCLIENT TERMINAL:[*] '*'\nSTATUS:[*] '*'\nDBID:[*] '*'" as totallength, actionlength, Action, databaseuserlength, databaseUser, privilegelength, privilege, clientuserlength, clientUser, clientterminallength, clientTerminal, statuslength, status, dbidlength, dbid
| where status!="0" and Action="CONNECT" // Failed Connection
| fields Action, databaseUser, privilege, clientUser, clientTerminal, status, dbid
| timeslice 5m
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, Action, databaseUser, privilege, clientUser, clientTerminal, status, dbid
| 5 as FailThreshold
| where eventCount > FailThreshold
| sort by _timeslice

panels.title: Multiple Database User Logons From Same UserHost

queries.queryString:
db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "STATUS:[1] '0'" "ACTION :[7] 'CONNECT'"
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message "
LENGTH : '*'
ACTION :[*] '*'
DATABASE USER:[*] '*'
PRIVILEGE :[*] '*'
CLIENT USER:[*] '*'
CLIENT TERMINAL:[*] '*'
STATUS:[*] '*'
DBID:[*] '*'
SESSIONID:[*] '*'
USERHOST:[*] '*'
CLIENT ADDRESS:[*] '*'
ACTION NUMBER:[*] '*'" as totallength, actionlength, Action, databaseuserlength, databaseUser, privilegelength, privilege, clientuserlength, clientUser, clientterminallength, clientTerminal, statuslength, status, dbidlength, dbid, sessionlength, sessionid, userhostlength, userHost, clientaddresslength, clientAddress, actionnumberlength, actionNumber
| where status="0" and Action="CONNECT" // Successful Connection
| fields Action, databaseUser, privilege, clientUser, clientTerminal, userHost, status, dbid

| 1 as threshold

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "ACTION :[7] 'CONNECT'"
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message "\nLENGTH : '*'\nACTION :[*] '*'\nDATABASE USER:[*] '*'\nPRIVILEGE :[*] '*'\nCLIENT USER:[*] '*'\nCLIENT TERMINAL:[*] '*'\nSTATUS:[*] '*'\nDBID:[*] '*'\nSESSIONID:[*] '*'\nUSERHOST:[*] '*'\nCLIENT ADDRESS:[*] '*'\nACTION NUMBER:[*] '*'" as totallength, actionlength, Action, databaseuserlength, databaseUser, privilegelength, privilege, clientuserlength, clientUser, clientterminallength, clientTerminal, statuslength, status, dbidlength, dbid, sessionlength, sessionid, userhostlength, userHost, clientaddresslength, clientAddress, actionnumberlength, actionNumber
| where Action="CONNECT" // Logon
| fields userHost, clientAddress, Action, databaseUser, privilege, clientUser, clientTerminal, status, dbid
| join ( where status="0") as t1,
(where status!="0") as t2
on t1.databaseUser=t2.databaseUser timewindow 30m
| (t1__messagetime-t2__messagetime) as timeGap | where (timeGap < 300000) and (timeGap>0)
| formatDate(fromMillis(t1__messagetime),"MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS Z") as LoginTime
| t1_databaseUser as databaseUser 
| t1_clientAddress as clientAddress 
| t1_userHost as userHost
| count as Attempts, max(t2__messagetime) as LastFailedEpoc by databaseUser, userHost, LoginTime, t1__messagetime 
| where Attempts > 2
| sort by t1__messagetime | formatDate(fromMillis(long(LastFailedEpoc)),"MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss.SSS Z") as LastFailedTime 
| fields -lastfailedepoc,t1__messagetime

panels.title: Definitions:
panels.text:
####**userHost**:  Client host machine name
####**Multiple Database User Logons From Same UserHost**: Lists UserHosts that successfully established connections using more than one database user
####**Multiple Client User Logons From Same UserHost**: Lists UserHosts that successfully established connections using more than one client user
####**Multiple UserHosts Logons with Same Database User**: Lists database users  that successfully established connections from the multiple user hosts
